# rising-stars
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="uz">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#000000">
<title>Rising Stars Education</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#030303;
    --glass:rgba(255,255,255,.045);
    --glass-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.075);
    --line:rgba(232,205,134,.18);
    --gold:#d4af5a;
    --gold-light:#f1dc9c;
    --gold-dark:#8f6f25;
    --white:#f7f4ec;
    --muted:#a09a8c;
    --danger:#ff8d7a;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
  html,body{min-height:100%}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--white);
    font-family:"Segoe UI","SF Pro Display","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    padding:max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px max(20px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
    overflow-x:hidden;position:relative;
  }

  /* ---------- background ---------- */
  .bg{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
  .bg::before,.bg::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(90px);opacity:.55;
  }
  .bg::before{width:60vmax;height:60vmax;left:-20vmax;top:-25vmax;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,90,.35),transparent 65%)}
  .bg::after{width:55vmax;height:55vmax;right:-22vmax;bottom:-28vmax;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(143,111,37,.38),transparent 65%)}
  .star{
    position:absolute;width:3px;height:3px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--gold-light);opacity:0;
    animation:twinkle var(--d,4s) ease-in-out var(--delay,0s) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes twinkle{0%,100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.6)}50%{opacity:.85;transform:scale(1.3)}}

  main{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;max-width:460px}

  /* ---------- card + screens ---------- */
  .card{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--glass-strong),var(--glass));
    border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:28px;
    padding:30px 24px 26px;
    backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
    box-shadow:0 30px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.9),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06);
    text-align:center;
  }
  .screen{display:none;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px}
  .screen.active{display:flex;animation:enter .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}
  @keyframes enter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

  .logo{width:min(62vw,250px);height:auto;border-radius:50%;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,90,.25),0 0 70px rgba(212,175,90,.28)}
  #welcome .logo{animation:glow 4s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes glow{
    0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,90,.25),0 0 50px rgba(212,175,90,.2)}
    50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,90,.4),0 0 95px rgba(212,175,90,.38)}
  }
  .logo.small{width:68px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(212,175,90,.25),0 0 30px rgba(212,175,90,.25);animation:none}

  h1,h2{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.25}
  h1{font-size:1.65rem}
  h2{font-size:1.35rem}
  .gold-text{
    background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold) 50%,var(--gold-light));
    -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  }
  p.lead{color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem;line-height:1.55;max-width:34ch}
  p.hint{color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.5}

  .chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;justify-content:center}
  .chip{
    padding:7px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:.82rem;color:var(--gold-light);
    border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(212,175,90,.07);
  }

  .stack{width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}

  /* ---------- progress ---------- */
  .progress{width:100%;display:none;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .progress.on{display:flex}
  .bars{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}
  .bars i{height:4px;border-radius:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);transition:background .3s}
  .bars i.done{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--gold-dark),var(--gold-light))}
  .progress span{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted);text-align:left}

  /* ---------- buttons ---------- */
  button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;color:inherit}
  .btn{
    width:100%;padding:16px 20px;border-radius:16px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold-light),var(--gold) 55%,var(--gold-dark));
    color:#1a1304;font-weight:700;font-size:1.03rem;letter-spacing:.01em;
    box-shadow:0 10px 30px -10px rgba(212,175,90,.65);
    transition:transform .12s ease,filter .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(1.08)}
  .btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:scale(.985)}
  .btn:disabled{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#6b6558;box-shadow:none;cursor:not-allowed}
  .btn.ghost{
    background:transparent;color:var(--gold-light);box-shadow:none;
    border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(212,175,90,.1)}
  .back{background:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px}
  .back:hover{color:var(--gold-light)}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold-light);outline-offset:3px}

  /* ---------- inputs ---------- */
  .field{width:100%;text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
  .field label{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);padding-left:4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between}
  .field label em{font-style:normal;color:#6f695c}
  input[type=text]{
    width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:16px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);color:var(--white);
    font:inherit;font-size:1.05rem;outline:none;
    transition:border-color .15s,box-shadow .15s;
  }
  input[type=text]::placeholder{color:#5f5a4e}
  input[type=text]:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(212,175,90,.14)}
  .error{color:var(--danger);font-size:.82rem;min-height:1.1em;padding-left:4px}

  /* ---------- course cards ---------- */
  .course{
    width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-align:left;
    padding:16px 18px;border-radius:20px;
    background:var(--glass);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
    transition:transform .15s ease,border-color .15s ease,background .15s ease;
  }
  .course:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(212,175,90,.08);transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .course:active{transform:scale(.985)}
  .ico{
    flex:none;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:16px;display:grid;place-items:center;
    background:linear-gradient(150deg,rgba(241,220,156,.2),rgba(143,111,37,.18));
    border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .ico svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:var(--gold-light);fill:none;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .course b{display:block;font-size:1.08rem;margin-bottom:3px}
  .course small{color:var(--muted);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.4}
  .course .arrow{margin-left:auto;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.3rem}

  /* ---------- time options ---------- */
  .picked{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 14px 8px 8px;border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(212,175,90,.07);font-size:.92rem;color:var(--gold-light);
  }
  .picked .ico{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%}
  .picked .ico svg{width:18px;height:18px}
  .option{
    width:100%;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:18px;text-align:left;
    background:var(--glass);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);
    font-size:1.02rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
    transition:border-color .15s,background .15s;
  }
  .option:hover{border-color:rgba(212,175,90,.5)}
  .option .dot{flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid var(--gold-dark);position:relative}
  .option[aria-checked=true]{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(212,175,90,.11)}
  .option[aria-checked=true] .dot{border-color:var(--gold)}
  .option[aria-checked=true] .dot::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold)}
  .option .tag{margin-left:auto;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--gold-light);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 9px}

  /* ---------- done ---------- */
  .check{
    width:92px;height:92px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,175,90,.22),transparent 70%);
    border:1.5px solid var(--gold);
    animation:pop .6s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1) both;
  }
  @keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.4);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
  .check svg{width:46px;height:46px;stroke:var(--gold-light);fill:none;stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;
    stroke-dasharray:40;stroke-dashoffset:40;animation:draw .5s .35s ease forwards}
  @keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
  .summary{
    width:100%;text-align:left;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 18px;
    background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .summary div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
  .summary div:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .summary dt{color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
  .summary dd{font-weight:600;text-align:right;font-size:.95rem}
  .status{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.84rem;color:var(--muted);min-height:1.4em;
  }
  .status i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted)}
  .status.ok i{background:#7fd99a}
  .status.wait i{background:var(--gold);animation:blink 1.2s infinite}
  @keyframes blink{50%{opacity:.25}}

  /* ---------- connection badge ---------- */
  .net{
    position:fixed;z-index:2;top:max(12px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:14px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:.76rem;color:var(--muted);
    padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  }
  .net i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#7fd99a}
  .net.off i{background:var(--danger)}

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
    .check svg{stroke-dashoffset:0}
    .star{opacity:.5}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="bg" id="bg" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div class="net" id="net"><i></i><span id="netText">Online</span></div>

<main>
  <div class="card">

    <div class="progress" id="progress" aria-hidden="true">
      <div class="bars"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
      <span id="stepLabel"></span>
    </div>

    <!-- 1. Welcome -->
    <section id="welcome" class="screen active">
      <img class="logo" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Rising Stars Education logotipi">
      <h1 class="gold-text">Welcome to Rising Stars Education center!</h1>
      <p class="lead">Kursga yozilish bir necha soniya vaqt oladi.</p>
      <div class="chips"><span class="chip">Ingliz tili</span><span class="chip">Rus tili</span><span class="chip">Matematika</span></div>
      <div class="stack"><button class="btn" id="startBtn">Davom etish</button></div>
    </section>

    <!-- 2. Name -->
    <section id="nameScreen" class="screen">
      <img class="logo small" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="">
      <h2>Tanishib olaylik</h2>
      <p class="lead">Ism va familiyangizni kiriting.</p>
      <div class="stack">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="firstName">Ism</label>
          <input type="text" id="firstName" autocomplete="given-name" maxlength="40">
          <div class="error" id="firstErr"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="lastName">Familiya <em>majburiy emas</em></label>
          <input type="text" id="lastName" autocomplete="family-name" maxlength="40">
        </div>
        <button class="btn" id="nameNext" disabled>Davom etish</button>
      </div>
      <button class="back" data-back="welcome">Orqaga</button>
    </section>

    <!-- 3. Course -->
    <section id="courseScreen" class="screen">
      <h2>Kursni tanlang</h2>
      <p class="lead" id="courseLead"></p>
      <div class="stack">
        <button class="course" data-course="english">
          <span class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.2 3 14.8 0 18M12 3c-3 3.2-3 14.8 0 18"/></svg></span>
          <span><b>Ingliz Tili</b><small>3 ta vaqt, Multilevel guruh ham bor</small></span>
          <span class="arrow">›</span>
        </button>
        <button class="course" data-course="russian">
          <span class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16v11H9l-5 4z"/><path d="M8 9.5h8M8 12.5h5"/></svg></span>
          <span><b>Rus Tili</b><small>Dushanba, Chorshanba va Juma kunlari</small></span>
          <span class="arrow">›</span>
        </button>
        <button class="course" data-course="math">
          <span class="ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5v14"/><path d="M4 21l16-18" opacity=".0"/></svg></span>
          <span><b>Matematika</b><small>Se, Pay, Shanba yoki Du, Chor, Juma</small></span>
          <span class="arrow">›</span>
        </button>
      </div>
      <button class="back" data-back="nameScreen">Orqaga</button>
    </section>

    <!-- 4. Time -->
    <section id="timeScreen" class="screen">
      <div class="picked"><span class="ico" id="pickedIco"></span><span id="pickedName"></span></div>
      <h2 id="timeTitle"></h2>
      <p class="hint" id="timeHint"></p>
      <div class="stack" id="timeOptions" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Dars vaqti"></div>
      <div class="stack"><button class="btn" id="confirmBtn" disabled>Tasdiqlash</button></div>
      <button class="back" data-back="courseScreen">Orqaga</button>
    </section>

    <!-- 5. Done -->
    <section id="doneScreen" class="screen">
      <div class="check" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg></div>
      <h2 class="gold-text" id="doneText"></h2>
      <dl class="summary">
        <div><dt>Ism</dt><dd id="sumName"></dd></div>
        <div><dt>Kurs</dt><dd id="sumCourse"></dd></div>
        <div><dt>Vaqt</dt><dd id="sumTime"></dd></div>
      </dl>
      <div class="status" id="sendStatus" role="status"><i></i><span></span></div>
      <div class="stack"><button class="btn ghost" id="againBtn">Yangi ro‘yxatdan o‘tish</button></div>
    </section>

  </div>
</main>

<script>
(function(){
  var EMAIL = "amir1408sentabr@gmail.com";
  var QUEUE_KEY = "rs_email_queue";
  var LOG_KEY = "rs_registrations";

  var ICONS = {
    english:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3c3 3.2 3 14.8 0 18M12 3c-3 3.2-3 14.8 0 18"/></svg>',
    russian:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16v11H9l-5 4z"/><path d="M8 9.5h8M8 12.5h5"/></svg>',
    math:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14M12 5v14"/></svg>'
  };

  var COURSES = {
    english:{
      label:"Ingliz tili", name:"Ingliz Tili",
      title:"O‘zingiz uchun qulay vaqt tanlang. Dars kunlarini ustoz aytadilar",
      done:"Tabriklaymiz siz bizning Ingliz tili darslarimizga yozildingiz!",
      times:[{t:"9:30 dan 11:00 gacha"},{t:"14:00 dan 15:30 gacha"},{t:"Multilevel 17:00 dan 19:00 gacha"}]
    },
    russian:{
      label:"Rus tili", name:"Rus Tili",
      title:"O‘zingiz uchun qulay vaqt tanlang. Darslar Dushanba, Chorshanba va Juma kunlari",
      done:"Tabriklaymiz siz bizning Rus tili darslarimizga yozildingiz!",
      times:[{t:"9:30 dan 11:00 gacha"},{t:"15:30 dan 17:00 gacha"}]
    },
    math:{
      label:"Matematika", name:"Matematika",
      title:"O‘zingiz uchun qulay vaqt tanlang",
      done:"Tabriklaymiz siz bizning Matematika darslarimizga yozildingiz!",
      times:[{t:"Se, Pay, Shanba 8:00 dan 9:30 gacha"},{t:"Du, Chor, Juma 17:00 dan 18:30-19:00 gacha"}]
    }
  };

  var STEPS = {welcome:0,nameScreen:1,courseScreen:2,timeScreen:3,doneScreen:4};
  var STEP_LABEL = {nameScreen:"1-qadam: Ism",courseScreen:"2-qadam: Kurs",timeScreen:"3-qadam: Vaqt"};

  var state = {first:"", last:"", course:null, time:null};
  var $ = function(id){return document.getElementById(id)};

  /* ---------- background stars ---------- */
  (function(){
    var bg = $("bg");
    for(var i=0;i<46;i++){
      var s = document.createElement("span");
      s.className = "star";
      s.style.left = Math.random()*100 + "%";
      s.style.top = Math.random()*100 + "%";
      s.style.setProperty("--d", (3+Math.random()*4).toFixed(1)+"s");
      s.style.setProperty("--delay", (Math.random()*5).toFixed(1)+"s");
      var sz = 2 + Math.random()*2.5;
      s.style.width = s.style.height = sz + "px";
      bg.appendChild(s);
    }
  })();

  /* ---------- navigation ---------- */
  function show(id){
    var all = document.querySelectorAll(".screen");
    for(var i=0;i<all.length;i++) all[i].classList.remove("active");
    $(id).classList.add("active");

    var step = STEPS[id];
    var prog = $("progress");
    if(step>=1 && step<=3){
      prog.classList.add("on");
      var bars = prog.querySelectorAll("i");
      for(var j=0;j<bars.length;j++) bars[j].classList.toggle("done", j<step);
      $("stepLabel").textContent = STEP_LABEL[id];
    } else prog.classList.remove("on");

    if(id==="nameScreen") setTimeout(function(){$("firstName").focus()}, 60);
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
  }

  $("startBtn").onclick = function(){ show("nameScreen"); };

  /* ---------- name ---------- */
  var first = $("firstName"), last = $("lastName"), nameNext = $("nameNext"), firstErr = $("firstErr");
  function checkName(){
    var v = first.value.trim();
    nameNext.disabled = v.length === 0;
    firstErr.textContent = (first.value.length>0 && v.length===0) ? "Ismni kiriting" : "";
  }
  first.addEventListener("input", checkName);
  [first,last].forEach(function(el){
    el.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
      if(e.key==="Enter" && !nameNext.disabled) nameNext.click();
    });
  });
  nameNext.onclick = function(){
    state.first = first.value.trim();
    state.last = last.value.trim();
    $("courseLead").textContent = state.first + ", o‘zingizga kerakli yo‘nalishni tanlang.";
    show("courseScreen");
  };

  /* ---------- course ---------- */
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-course]").forEach(function(b){
    b.onclick = function(){
      state.course = b.getAttribute("data-course");
      state.time = null;
      buildTimes();
      show("timeScreen");
    };
  });
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-back]").forEach(function(b){
    b.onclick = function(){ show(b.getAttribute("data-back")); };
  });

  /* ---------- time ---------- */
  function buildTimes(){
    var c = COURSES[state.course];
    $("pickedIco").innerHTML = ICONS[state.course];
    $("pickedName").textContent = c.name;
    $("timeTitle").textContent = c.title;
    $("timeHint").textContent = "Faqat bitta variantni tanlash mumkin.";
    var box = $("timeOptions");
    box.innerHTML = "";
    $("confirmBtn").disabled = true;
    c.times.forEach(function(item){
      var o = document.createElement("button");
      o.type = "button";
      o.className = "option";
      o.setAttribute("role","radio");
      o.setAttribute("aria-checked","false");
      o.innerHTML = '<span class="dot"></span><span class="txt"></span>';
      o.querySelector(".txt").textContent = item.t;
      o.onclick = function(){
        box.querySelectorAll(".option").forEach(function(x){x.setAttribute("aria-checked","false")});
        o.setAttribute("aria-checked","true");
        state.time = item.t;
        $("confirmBtn").disabled = false;
      };
      box.appendChild(o);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- confirm ---------- */
  $("confirmBtn").onclick = function(){
    var c = COURSES[state.course];
    var fullName = (state.first + " " + state.last).trim();
    var text = fullName + " bu odam " + state.time + " " + c.label + " kursiga yozildi";

    var record = {
      id: Date.now() + "-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),
      name: fullName, course: c.label, time: state.time, text: text,
      date: new Date().toLocaleString("uz-UZ") 
    };
    push(LOG_KEY, record);
    push(QUEUE_KEY, record);

    $("doneText").textContent = c.done;
    $("sumName").textContent = fullName;
    $("sumCourse").textContent = c.label;
    $("sumTime").textContent = state.time;
    setStatus("wait","Yuborilmoqda...");
    show("doneScreen");
    flushQueue(true);
  };

  $("againBtn").onclick = function(){
    first.value = ""; last.value = ""; nameNext.disabled = true; firstErr.textContent = "";
    state = {first:"", last:"", course:null, time:null};
    show("welcome");
  };

  /* ---------- storage + email queue ---------- */
  function read(key){
    try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)) || []; }catch(e){ return []; }
  }
  function write(key, arr){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(arr)); }catch(e){}
  }
  function push(key, item){ var a = read(key); a.push(item); write(key, a); }

  function setStatus(kind, msg){
    var s = $("sendStatus");
    s.className = "status " + kind;
    s.querySelector("span").textContent = msg;
  }

  var sending = false;
  function flushQueue(showStatus){
    if(sending) return;
    var q = read(QUEUE_KEY);
    if(!q.length) return;
    if(!navigator.onLine){
      if(showStatus) setStatus("wait","Internet yo‘q. Ma’lumot saqlandi, internet paydo bo‘lganda yuboriladi.");
      return;
    }
    sending = true;
    var item = q[0];
    fetch("https://formsubmit.co/ajax/" + EMAIL, {
      method:"POST",
      headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json","Accept":"application/json"},
      body:JSON.stringify({
        _subject:"Rising Stars: yangi ro‘yxatdan o‘tish — " + item.name,
        _template:"table",
        _captcha:"false",
        Xabar:item.text,
        Ism:item.name,
        Kurs:item.course,
        Vaqt:item.time,
        Sana:item.date
      })
    }).then(function(r){
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error("http " + r.status);
      var cur = read(QUEUE_KEY).filter(function(x){return x.id !== item.id});
      write(QUEUE_KEY, cur);
      sending = false;
      if(showStatus && !cur.length) setStatus("ok","Ma’lumot yuborildi");
      flushQueue(false);
    }).catch(function(){
      sending = false;
      if(showStatus) setStatus("wait","Ma’lumot saqlandi, keyinroq yuboriladi.");
    });
  }

  /* ---------- connection badge ---------- */
  function updateNet(){
    var on = navigator.onLine;
    $("net").classList.toggle("off", !on);
    $("netText").textContent = on ? "Online" : "Offline rejim";
  }
  window.addEventListener("online", function(){ updateNet(); flushQueue(false); });
  window.addEventListener("offline", updateNet);
  updateNet();
  flushQueue(false);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
